context: Riku and Aoi chat about a hobby collection.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (久々/そのうち/コレクション/損/どころ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 久々に、カードを集め直したんだ!
lines.en: I started collecting cards again after a long time!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、コレクション増えた?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、コレクションが、どんどん増えてるよ。
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 高いと、損した気分にならない?
lines.en: When it's pricey, don't you feel you lost out?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 損どころか、価値が上がってるんだ。
lines.en: Far from a loss, the value's going up.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: すごい!そのうち、お宝になるかもね。
lines.en: Amazing! It might become treasure eventually.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そのうち、全部揃えたいな。
lines.en: Eventually I want to complete the set.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 久々の趣味、楽しそうだね!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
